mapper.sql: uuid, external_id, organization_uuid, workspace_uuid, vault_uuid, vault_external_id, created_by_api_key_uuid, display_name, metadata, auth_type, credential_key, auth, ciphertext, nonce, wrapped_dek, format_version, key_provider, key_version, version, created_at, updated_at, archived_at, deleted_at
mapper.update: UPDATE vault_credentials SET archived_at = COALESCE(archived_at, NOW()), ciphertext = NULL, nonce = NULL, wrapped_dek = NULL, format_version = NULL, key_provider = NULL, key_version = NULL, updated_at = NOW() WHERE workspace_uuid = #{workspaceUUID} AND vault_uuid = #{vaultUUID} AND deleted_at IS NULL
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO vault_credentials ( uuid, external_id, organization_uuid, workspace_uuid, vault_uuid, vault_external_id, created_by_api_key_uuid, display_name, metadata, auth_type, credential_key, auth, ciphertext, nonce, wrapped_dek, format_version, key_provider, key_version, version, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{params.UUID}, #{params.ExternalID}, #{params.OrganizationUUID}, #{params.WorkspaceUUID}, #{params.VaultUUID}, #{params.VaultExternalID}, #{params.CreatedByAPIKeyUUID}, #{params.DisplayName}, CAST(#{params.Metadata} AS jsonb), #{params.AuthType}, #{params.CredentialKey,sensitive=true}, CAST(#{params.Auth,sensitive=true} AS jsonb), #{params.Ciphertext,sensitive=true}, #{params.Nonce,sensitive=true}, #{params.WrappedDEK,sensitive=true}, #{params.FormatVersion}, #{params.KeyProvider}, #{params.KeyVersion}, #{params.Version}, #{params.CreatedAt}, #{params.CreatedAt} ) RETURNING
mapper.update: UPDATE vault_credentials SET display_name = #{params.DisplayName}, metadata = CAST(#{params.Metadata} AS jsonb), credential_key = #{params.CredentialKey,sensitive=true}, auth = CAST(#{params.Auth,sensitive=true} AS jsonb), ciphertext = #{params.Ciphertext,sensitive=true}, nonce = #{params.Nonce,sensitive=true}, wrapped_dek = #{params.WrappedDEK,sensitive=true}, format_version = #{params.FormatVersion}, key_provider = #{params.KeyProvider}, key_version = #{params.KeyVersion}, version = version + 1, updated_at = #{params.UpdatedAt} WHERE workspace_uuid = #{params.WorkspaceUUID} AND vault_external_id = #{params.VaultExternalID} AND external_id = #{params.CredentialExternalID} AND deleted_at IS NULL AND archived_at IS NULL AND version = #{params.ExpectedVersion} RETURNING
